g.text: Platform Core & Services - Comprehensive Class Diagram (Iteration 1)
3. UI subscribes to PlatformCore; UI does
+registerPlayer(firstName: String, lastName: String, password: String): String
+validateCredentials(firstName: String, lastName: String, password: String): Validation
+submitMove(sessionId: String, playerId: String, move: Object): MoveSubmissionResult
+sendChatMessage(sessionId: String, senderId: String, text: String): void
+createRoom(hostId: String, gameType: String, maxPlayers: int): Room
+startSession(roomId: String, gameType: String, players: List<String>): String
+submitMove(sessionId: String, playerId: String, move: Object): MoveSubmissionResult
+logGameResult(sessionId: String, winnerId: String, loserId: String, isDraw: boolean): void
Networking is no longer a stub.
Real WebSocket server lives in server/
- Per-game queues with MMR range expansion
- PlatformCore polls every 5 s via scheduler
